title: ViRaSPA
tagline: A vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript single-page application framework.
browserNote: Runs in current Edge, Chrome, Firefox and Safari. On startup the framework checks the browser features it needs, and shows a clear message instead of a blank page if any are missing (or if JavaScript is off).
sampleApiLabel: Live sample: first 5 users from a public demo API (jsonplaceholder.typicode.com)
